findings.priority_reason: Address before adopting the affected capability in Eumenes.
findings.title: Host-specific infrastructure remains inside reusable memory paths
findings.condition: Move MemorySystem to an independent repository consumed by Eumenes
findings.consequence: Current memory module cannot be consumed by replacing one host adapter; queue/runtime/provider dependencies must be separated.
findings.counterevidence: personal-state-core already has an IO-free boundary and passed scoped tests.
findings.fix: Keep core; introduce host ports for sources, storage transactions, job claims, inference and acceptance. Do not copy a second scheduler.
findings.verification: Contract fixture suite runs without Tauri/LARM/app tables; Eumenes adapter uses one existing writer and queue.

impacts.reason: Current memory module cannot be consumed by replacing one host adapter; queue/runtime/provider dependencies must be separated.

findings.priority_reason: Address before adopting the affected capability in Eumenes.
findings.title: Foreground Personal State views load global history
findings.root_cause: Scoped view uses global Ledger load
findings.condition: Long-lived memory grows, including history unrelated to the active scope
findings.consequence: Work per view and acceptance grows with unrelated source/assertion history; lookup work is not bounded by requested scope.
findings.counterevidence: World has scoped dependency-closure loading; no latency budget failure measured in this review.
findings.fix: Select scoped roots plus required source/dependency closure; keep a cheap revision/eligibility check for acceptance.
findings.verification: Equivalent view and invalidation fixtures; query-row/heap and p50/p95 comparisons at 1k/10k/100k records across scopes.

impacts.reason: Work per view and acceptance grows with unrelated source/assertion history; lookup work is not bounded by requested scope.

findings.priority_reason: Address before adopting the affected capability in Eumenes.
findings.title: Record forgetting is incomplete across backup restore
findings.root_cause: Journal sync/replay and records visibility do not share one invalidation contract
findings.condition: Restore a pre-forget record row and replay external record tombstone journal
findings.consequence: Restored row remains eligible under records auth predicate; additionally normal sync never records record tombstones.
findings.counterevidence: Normal forget updates forget_epoch/removes storage; insert trigger blocks resurrection of new rows. Probe does not establish live production exposure.
findings.fix: Persist record tombstones and replay full record invalidation before reads; defense-in-depth tombstone filter; verify descendants and blobs.
findings.verification: Forget a real captured record, restart, restore older DB with current journal: read/search/derived views absent, repeated restore idempotent, missing/corrupt journal blocks reads.

impacts.reason: Restored row remains eligible under records auth predicate; additionally normal sync never records record tombstones.
